 The “KPop Demon Hunters” Golden World Tour will hit the stage at TD Coliseum on June 26 for two shows.
 Bay Mills Studios 
 By  Fallon Hewitt Reporter 
 Hamilton is going up, up, up — and it’s going to be golden.
 The “KPop Demon Hunters” Golden World Tour will hit the stage at TD Coliseum on June 26 for two shows, Oak View Group (OVG) announced Friday — bringing the stars of the animated smash Netflix movie to Steeltown.
 The shows will see HUNTR/X characters Rumi, Mira and Zoey interact with the audience through “cutting-edge performance innovations” that will take the Kpop girl group, plus other characters such as the Saja Boys and Derpy Tiger, off the screen and into real life.
 “Every fan in attendance will play a part,” OVG wrote in a media release. “More than a concert, this is a first-of-its-kind production that immerses fans in the storytelling with live-action stunts and performers, fan-favourite music and choreography, and special performances.”
 ARTICLE CONTINUES BELOW 
 “KPop Demon Hunters” premiered on Netflix in June 2025, becoming a global phenomenon for the streaming platform and hitting more than 670 million views, according to the release. 
 Its soundtrack, featuring hits such as “Golden,” “Strategy,” “How It’s Done” and “Takedown,” has racked up billions of streams on Spotify, with “Golden” becoming the first K-pop track to win both an Oscar and a Grammy, the release added.
 “This fandom was never about a single moment, and the Golden World Tour is how we keep it going — bringing that ‘Takedown’ energy to arenas around the world, where fans can sing, dance and help HUNTR/X seal the Honmoon,” Netflix chief marketing officer Marian Lee said in a statement.
 The tour starts in June, with Hamilton as the only Canadian stop announced so far. It will also visit big cities such as Baltimore, Chicago, Los Angeles, Atlanta and Las Vegas.
 The Hamilton date will feature two shows, including a matinee.
 Ticket presales start Nov. 18, with general ticket sales starting Nov. 20. For more information, visit kpopdemonhunterstour.com .
